findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

An employee was observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet. Education was conducted with the PIC and they were instructed to review hand washing with staff and conduct oversight as needed. Ensure proper hand washing at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the inspector observed the bar three part sink to have a low concentration in their sanitizing bin. The PIC was notified and strengthened the newly made solution to correctly. Ensure that all sanitizers are at effective levels at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the baffle of the ice machine to be soiled. Discussed with PIC, and PIC immediately cleaned and sanitized the baffle of the ice machine. Ensure the baffle of the ice machine is cleaned regularly enough to keep it clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the walls and triple sink in the dish room to have holes in them. Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure these holes are repaired in a way that makes the wall and triple sink surface smooth, durable, and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
1) Inspector observed the walls in the kitchen to have a build-up of dust. They are made from textured cinderblock, which holds dust in its crevices. Ensure these walls are cleaned regularly enough to prevent dust from building up.

2) Inspector observed a hole in the ceiling of the walk-in cooler. Discussed with PIC. Ensure this hole is repaired to create a smooth, durable, and easily cleanable surface. 

6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

An employee was observed to use a sanitizer rag to wipe down a counter, and then immediately put on gloves and begin handling foods. No hand washing was observed. The PIC was notified and instructed to review hand washing practices with staff and ensure that hand washing is taking place at all times that it should be.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.comment:
3-301.11: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall properly wash hands (C). (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall not contact RTE FOODS with bare hands  except washing fruits and veggies (P). 

The ice scoop in the bar area is observed with the handle in contact with the ice. This situation would require the bartender’s hand to come into contact with the Ready-To-Eat (RTE) food (ice) when grabbing the scoop. Education was conducted and the scoop moved to correct. Ensure that bare hands are not put into contact with RTE foods at any time.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

On arrival the kitchen hand sink was blocked by cases of soda syrup and a step ladder. The items were moved during the inspection to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained accessible at all times.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

On arrival the hand sink in the kitchen area was without paper towels. The PIC was notified and paper towels supplied during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained properly supplied at all times.
